speaker: Government Representative
text: Arcadia became prosperous through trade, shipping, and industrial production.

speaker: Government Representative
text: Our ports connect international markets across the world.

speaker: Government Representative
text: Thousands of families rely on these industries for their livelihoods.

speaker: Government Representative
text: But prosperity has come with consequences

speaker: Government Representative
text: Much of our economy still depends heavily on fossil fuels

speaker: Government Representative
text: Our emissions continue to place pressure on both our environment and our international climate commitments.

speaker: Government Representative
text: If we fail to transition toward sustainable energy soon, Arcadia risks economic instability and long-term environmental damage.

speaker: Government Representative
text: Come. The council is waiting at Town Hall.
